questions.question: If a sum of money triples in four years at compound interest, then in how many years will that amount become 27 times at the same interest rate?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Express the target. 
27 = 3³  ⇒  three tripling periods 
 Step 2   Each takes 4 years. 
3 × 4 = 12 years

questions.question: If the different between simple interest and compound interest on a certain sum of money at 10% per annum for 3 years is equal to ₹310, then what is the interest on that sum?
questions.solution:
Step 1   The identity. 
CI − SI = P × (r/100)² × (3 + r/100) 
 Step 2   At 10% it collapses. 
P × 0.01 × 3.1 = 0.031 P = 310   ∴  P = ₹10,000

questions.question: Water is pouring into a cuboidal reservoir at the rate of 50 liters per minute. If the volume of reservoir is 120 m³. Find the number of hours that it will take to fill the reservoir?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Convert the reservoir to litres. 
120 m³ = 120 × 1,000 = 1,20,000 litres 
 Step 2   Divide by the rate. 
1,20,000 / 50 = 2,400 minutes 
 Step 3   The question asks for hours. 
2,400 / 60 = 40 hours

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank of capacity 350 litres in 3½ minutes, pipe B can fill a tank of capacity 780 liters in 8⅔ minutes. How long (in min) will it take to fill a tank of capacity 1615 liters, if both pipes are opened together?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Litres per minute for each pipe. 
A : 350 / 3½ = 100 L/min        B : 780 / (26/3) = 
90 L/min 
 Step 2   Running together. 
100 + 90 = 190 L/min 
 Step 3   Time for the 1,615-litre tank. 
1,615 / 190 = 8½ minutes
